faq: Will you promise a perfect speed score?
No. Scores depend on your theme, apps and platform, and a perfect score is not the goal. We aim for clear improvements that shoppers notice, and show the numbers before and after.
Will removing apps break my store?
We check what each app does before touching it and test the store afterward. We never remove an app without telling you, and we keep a way back.
